message.content: Alex’s reply is simply an acknowledgement and approval of Jordan’s plan. By saying “Sure, that’s fine,” Alex is indicating that he’s okay with Jordan finishing the work tonight and that the arrangement works for him. In other words, Alex is giving his consent and letting Jordan know there’s no problem with the proposed timeline.
